hero.title: Voice Command Canvas
hero.subtitle: Say a word. The ball moves.
hero.tagline: A React page that loads the TensorFlow.js speech-commands model in the browser and drives a canvas ball with spoken words.
hero.impact: up, down, left, and right move the ball 10 pixels. zero through nine set the radius to 10 times that digit. The model only accepts a score at or above 0.9.

problems.d: speech.create('BROWSER_FFT') builds the recognizer. ensureModelLoaded waits, then wordLabels() is stored for the listener.
The winning label moves x or y by 10, or, for a number word, sets the radius. Anything else is ignored.
A 600×600 canvas redraws one ball from x, y, and r whenever the action changes.
The login route asks for a name and pushes /game. It does not check the name.

layers.title: React Router 5
layers.desc: / renders the name form. /game renders the canvas. Anything else redirects

layers.title: speech-commands
layers.desc: BROWSER_FFT recognizer. Command starts model.listen with includeSpectrogram and probabilityThreshold 0.9

layers.title: argMax
layers.desc: The highest score index is mapped through wordLabels() and stored as the action

layers.title: Canvas
layers.desc: drawBall paints the circle. The action is then reset to base so the same word does not repeat

highlights: Listen button with a 0.9 probability threshold
Direction words nudge the ball by 10 pixels
Number words set radius to 10 × digit
600×600 canvas and the current word on screen
